text: My name is Abhay Waghamode.I am a motivated and detail-oriented Computer Science student specializing in Artificial Intelligence at G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering and Management, Pune. My academic journey has helped me develop a strong foundation in computer science, particularly in areas such as Data Structures and Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Machine Learning, Operating Systems, Database Management Systems, and Artificial Intelligence. My primary interests lie in software development, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and competitive programming. I have developed skills in programming languages including Python, C, C++, and Java, along with knowledge of HTML, CSS, APIs, and development tools such as VS Code, GitHub, and PyCharm.

One of my notable projects is Marcos – PDF Question Answering System, which I developed between January and March 2025. The project involved creating a Python-based application capable of reading and processing PDF documents for information extraction. I integrated the OpenAI API to generate context-aware answers based on the content of PDF documents. The system involved text extraction, preprocessing, and prompt engineering to improve the relevance of generated responses. I also designed it to work efficiently with large documents and provide useful insights from unstructured information.
